name: Jiyan Hypercarry
description: Standard high-octane Aero hypercarry setup. Mortefi supplies a massive 38% Heavy Attack Deepen and coordinated strikes, while Verina delivers universal 15% All-DMG Deepen, rapid concerto build, and robust team heals.
strengths: Mortefi +38% Heavy Attack Deepen perfectly amplifies Qingloong heavy attack mode
High AoE crowd control and vortex suction during Jiyan's Liberation
Very fast and reliable Concerto rotations from Mortefi and Verina
Full team survivability with Verina's heals and death prevention shield
weaknesses: Jiyan requires high field time to deplete dragon gauge
Mortefi is vulnerable during pistol combos without interruption resistance
Aero-resistant enemies noticeably slow down clear times

name: Camellya Hypercarry
description: Devastating basic-attack Havoc hypercarry team. Sanhua brings lightning-fast 5-second concerto rotations and a 38% Basic Attack amplification, coupled with Shorekeeper's domain of guaranteed crit rate, crit damage, and damage amplification.
strengths: Sanhua provides +38% Basic Attack Deepen matching Camellya's primary damage source
Shorekeeper offers team-wide Crit Rate and Crit DMG domain amplification
Sanhua boasts the fastest concerto generation speed in Wuthering Waves
Extreme mobility and wide-sweeping Havoc AoE blossoms
weaknesses: Camellya can be knocked out of mid-air vine combos without proper timing
Demands precise detonation timing for Sanhua's ice spikes
No secondary shielder; relies solely on Shorekeeper's domain healing

name: Xiangli Yao Electro Burst
description: Premier Electro burst squad. Yinlin imparts 20% Electro Deepen and 25% Resonance Liberation Deepen directly into Xiangli Yao's devastating Liberation matrix activations, supported by Verina's universal damage amplify.
strengths: Yinlin's Outro delivers an exact dual match: +20% Electro DMG and +25% Resonance Liberation DMG
Continuous off-field Electro coordinated attacks from Yinlin's Judgment Marks
Smooth quickswap windows between Yao's matrix cubes and Yinlin's puppet strikes
Verina secures consistent ATK buffs and rapid concerto cycling
weaknesses: Demands tight Outro execution before Xiangli Yao enters his Law of Logic state
Both Xiangli Yao and Yinlin compete for high-level Rectifier/Gauntlet echo sets
Single-target bias on Xiangli Yao's primary slam combos

name: Jinhsi Skill Nuke
description: Highest single-instance damage ceiling in the game. Zhezhi provides off-field coordinated Glacio attacks to stack Jinhsi's Incandescence gauge while buffing Skill DMG by 25% and Glacio by 20%. Shorekeeper maximizes nuke crits.
strengths: Zhezhi supplies +25% Resonance Skill Deepen, directly scaling Illuminous Epiphany
Multi-element off-field coordinated attacks quickly cap Jinhsi's 50 Incandescence stacks
Shorekeeper's domain virtually eliminates non-critical strike misses on the skill nuke
Outstanding aerial combat safety and elevation advantage
weaknesses: Substantial DPS loss if Jinhsi's Dragon breath nuke misses or fails to crit
Longer rotation window required to properly charge Zhezhi's phantasms
Heavy reliance on 5-star characters across all three slots

name: Changli Quickswap

strengths: Changli grants +20% Fusion DMG and +25% Resonance Liberation DMG to Encore

Encore can safely switch out during heavy skill animations while continuing damage
Tremendous burst potential against aggressive boss encounters
weaknesses: High mechanical skill required to maximize animation canceling and intro triggers
Tight dodge timings needed due to frequent character swaps in melee range
Strict rotation discipline necessary to avoid overwriting Outro buffs
